title: Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin Texas, New York, San Francisco</strong></p> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The Strategy organization operates as a high-velocity engine at the intersection of business, technology, and go-to-market execution, driving enterprise growth, global expansion, market innovation, and strategic execution. Our multi-disciplinary team spans seven core strategic pillars: Network & Infrastructure Strategy, Industry Solutions, Strategic Partnerships, International Expansion, Executive Customer Engagements, Corporate Development & M&A, and the new business model of the Internet. As primary connective tissue across the enterprise, we collaborate closely with Sales, Product & Engineering, Finance, Legal, and Policy to translate corporate vision into measurable, real-world execution.</p> <h2>Role Summary</h2> <p>As a Senior Strategic Partner Manager, you will work directly with Product, Engineering, and executive leadership to identify, build, and launch key partnerships that accelerate our product roadmap and drive platform adoption.</p> <p>The initiatives you own will span strategic co-build integrations, OEM relationships, and complex GTM alliance build-outs. This is a hands-on execution role for a versatile problem-solver—you will own partnerships end-to-end, moving from initial strategic alignment through technical scoping, contract negotiation, integration, and go-to-market launch.</p> <p>You will flex across different technology domains as company priorities shift, diving into technical details, validating integration use cases, and bringing cross-functional teams (Legal, Security, GTM, Finance) together to deliver real outcomes.</p> <h2>Role Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Identify, evaluate, and structure strategic partnerships (technology integrations, ecosystem plays, and go-to-market alliances) across Cloudflare's product areas, prioritizing based on where the business needs it most.</li> <li>Partner directly with Product and Engineering leaders to assess technical fit, integration approach, and roadmap alignment for prospective partnerships.</li> <li>Build the business case for each partnership: sizing the opportunity, validating the underlying use case, and making a clear, evidence-based recommendation on whether to pursue it.</li> <li>Lead negotiation and execution end-to-end, from initial scoping through signed agreement and launch.</li> <li>Act as the connective tissue between partner organizations and internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing, Sales) to ensure both organizations deliver outcomes. </li> <li>Move fluidly across product areas and partner types as priorities shift, ramping up on new technical domains quickly and independently.</li> <li>Demonstrate deep technical fluency. You must be able to independently evaluate technical documentation and engage credibly with engineers, rather than relying on others to translate how a partner’s technology works. </li> </ul> <h2>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product management, strategy or consulting; ideally within a technology or cybersecurity organization. </li> <li>Prior exposure to cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, networking, developer platforms, or AI markets.</li> <li>Technical fluency: able to understand product architecture and engineering trade-offs well enough to independently evaluate partnership and integration opportunities, not just relay them.</li> <li>Proven ability to navigate unstructured, open-ended problems with an attention to detail to close and launch complex deals. </li> <li>A track record of aligning senior stakeholders across product, engineering, legal, GTM and partner organizations around competing priorities, keeping teams accountable, and pushing projects across the finish line. </li> <li>Experience structuring, negotiating, and closing non-standard commercial and technical agreements. </li> <li>Ability to pick up new technical domains quickly and shift focus as business priorities evolve. </li> <li>Executive-level written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence cross-functionally without formal authority.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Have Skills</h2> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent advanced degree.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.</p> <p>San Francisco Estimated Base salary $161,000 - $221,000.</p> <p>New York Estimated Base salary $153,000 - $210,000.</p> <p>Austin Estimated Base salary $125,000 - $172,000.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Sales Operations Manager, EMEA
description: About the Role As EMEA Sales Operations Lead, you'll build and scale the operational engine powering our regional Sales organization. Reporting to the Global Head of Revenue Operations, you’ll partner closely with EMEA Sales leadership to drive strategic planning, operational excellence, and data-driven decision making across the EMEA revenue funnel — while coordinating with the global Revenue Operations team to ensure alignment on systems, processes, and reporting standards. You will own core Sales Ops initiatives for the region including territory planning, forecasting support, pipeline management,and process optimization. This role requires a strategic operator who can balance close partnership with EMEA leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment. This is a hybrid role based in our Paris office. What You'll Do Serve as a trusted right hand to the EMEA GM and an active member of the GTM EMEA leadership team, providing operational insight that shapes regional strategy and decision-making Partner with EMEA Sales leadership to drive regional GTM strategy, territory design & planning, account prioritization, and performance optimization Establish operational rigor around forecasting, pipeline management, KPI definition, reporting, and business reviews for the EMEA region Own and optimize sales processes and workflows (along with your cross regional counterparts), coordinating with the global GTM Systems team to ensure consistency and scalability Serve as the EMEA voice into global sales compensation structures, incentive programs, and SPIFF strategies Drive adoption and standardization of Salesforce and core GTM tools within EMEA, in close partnership with the global GTM Systems team. Who You Are Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Revenue Operations or Sales Operations Strong experience supporting Sales and BDR/SDR motions in a high-growth environment Experience owning or partnering closely with Deal Desk operations Deep expertise with Salesforce and core revenue systems Comfort operating in a matrixed environment, partnering with regional leadership while coordinating with a global operations function Nice to Have: Experience with modern GTM tooling including Salesforce, Gong, and data enrichment platforms Experience driving AI-enabled workflows and automation within Revenue Operations Working knowledge of sales compensation design and GTM planning methodologies French, German, or another European language proficiency is a plus What We Offer Competitive compensation package (Highly competitive base salary, equity package, and comprehensive benefits). We encourage you to take the time you need. When you work hard, we know you also need to rest, which is why we offer generous time off and parental leave policies. High-end equipment to do your work in the best conditions. How We Work Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet. Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community. Go for it: We are biased toward action. Every action leads to learning, and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission. Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to changing our views, and approach conversations with empathy, knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment. Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our customers heroes in their organizations. title: Sales Development Senior Manager
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are hiring a Sales Development Senior Manager to join our Sales team in Berlin! This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office. YOUR IMPACT Act as the direct leader and mentor for our front-line Business Development Representative (BDR) team, fostering a culture of growth and purpose. Conduct live call-shadowing and deep-dive reviews to sharpen your team's ability to communicate the transformative power of Wellhub. Take full accountability for a team of 5–8 BDRs, guiding their professional journey and ensuring they hit the milestones that drive our mission forward. Lead the interview process for new talent and execute a seamless onboarding program that gets new starters hitting "active" status within 30 days. Excellence in building strong partnerships with marketing and sales. Deeply understand the UK B2B ecosystem to teach your team how to position wellbeing as a "business-critical" priority for CHROs and CFOs. Pivot messaging based on market shifts to ensure Wellhub remains a vital solution for companies navigating industry headwinds. Manage the "speed-to-lead" for inbound inquiries, ensuring high conversion rates through rigorous qualification. Work with the team to build hyper-personalised outbound "clusters." You'll move beyond generic sequences to high-intent, research-backed prospecting. Ensure the team is getting maximum ROI out of Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and AI-assisted prospecting tools. Develop the best-in-class strategies for managing the rep's book of business and running the outreach-prospecting playbook and turning curiosity into attention with intention. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE Proven Track Record: 5+ years in Sales, with at least 1-2 years of experience as a Lead BDR or Front-line Manager. The "Coach" DNA: A passion for seeing others succeed. You can look at a conversion funnel and pinpoint exactly where the "leak" is-whether it's the initial hook, the discovery call, or the hand-off to the AE. Proven experience managing SDR/BDR teams for a Challenger Brand or a "non-commodity" solution. You must demonstrate the ability to create urgency for a product that is not yet a "household name" or is perceived as discretionary spend. You have moved beyond "feature-selling" and can coach reps to pivot from Product Interest to Business Impact. You should be able to show how you've successfully positioned a solution as "mission-critical" during budget-conscious cycles. You are familiar with the HR space and can talk the CHRO language. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role is Hybrid, with a minimum of 2 days per week in-office . We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn ! Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Project Management: Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success. Skills: what you'll have Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions. title: Client Delivery Lead (f/m/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken Customer What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects. The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client. 🚀 What you'll own: You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners) You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform. Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have. This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role. We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation. You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party: In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! title: Langfuse - Product Engineer, Integrations
description: Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations. You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. Everything you build is open source and immediately visible. All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. What You’ll Do Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it. Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience. Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations. Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes. Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem. What We’re Looking For Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it. Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems. Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work? Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach. Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects. Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks. CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn. Bonus Points Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation Contributions to popular open source projects, SDKs, or developer tools Experience building developer tooling, CLIs, or client libraries Former founder or early startup experience Active presence in AI/ML developer communities (blog posts, talks, open source) No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply. Projects You Could Own Build and ship a Langfuse integration for an emerging agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, new OTEL-based instrumentation) Design the integration pattern for a new category of AI tools (e.g., voice agents via LiveKit/Pipecat) Create comprehensive quickstart cookbooks that get developers from zero to traced in under 5 minutes Work with the OpenTelemetry community to improve GenAI semantic conventions Maintain and upgrade our most popular integrations (OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) as those frameworks ship breaking changes Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. title: (Junior) Creative Director – Design & Brand (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Die Beratungsbranche in Deutschland sieht überall gleich aus. Gleiche Bildwelten, gleiche Stockfotos, gleiche Blautöne, gleiche Sprache. Marke ist in diesem Markt praktisch unbesetzt. Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Daraus bauen wir das Beratungshaus für den deutschen Mittelstand, und wir bauen es schnell. Diesen Markt gewinnt nicht, wer den besseren Fachaufsatz schreibt, sondern wer als Marke dauerhaft präsent ist und den Markt anführt — bei Unternehmern genauso wie bei den Menschen, die wir für uns gewinnen wollen. Genau diese Marke bauen wir: ikonisch, unverwechselbar, und in dieser Branche gibt es sie noch nicht. Design ist deshalb keine Abteilung am Ende der Kette: Was wir bauen, wird aus einer Designperspektive gedacht. Du bist Grafikdesigner mit außergewöhnlichem visuellem Gespür und einem Portfolio, das für sich spricht. Du kommst aus einer Agentur, einem eigenen Studio oder von einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Du wechselst, weil du dort immer nur einen Teilbereich verantwortest — eine Kampagne, ein Relaunch, eine Strecke im System — und nie die Marke als Ganzes samt der Experience dahinter verantworten und führen darfst. Genau das willst du: die volle visuelle Verantwortung, mit einem Auftraggeber, der dir das Urteil nicht wegnimmt. Die Rolle ist bewusst nach unten offen. Wenn du gerade aus einem starken Gestaltungsstudium oder einer gestalterischen Ausbildung kommst und deine Mappe das visuelle Urteil und die Systemtiefe zeigt, die diese Rolle braucht, bist du hier richtig — du startest dann am unteren Ende der Spanne, arbeitest zunächst an Teilen des Systems und wächst in die volle Verantwortung hinein. Das Portfolio entscheidet, nicht das Jahr des Abschlusses. Bei Vogel findest du beides: Strukturen, die tragen, und ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Kein Konzern-Korsett. Kein Aufbau-Versprechen ohne Boden. Du verantwortest das gesamte visuelle System von Vogel und der weiteren Marken, die daneben entstehen — Print, Digital, Raum, Bewegtbild, Experience. Du setzt selbst um und ziehst Partner dort zu, wo Kapazität oder Spezialisierung es erfordert. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Die Rolle sitzt in München, vor Ort. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in die fachliche Führung des Design- und Brand-Bereichs. Deine Verantwortung Visuelles System und Markenführung Du verantwortest das Designsystem von Vogel — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache, Layout-Prinzipien, Komponenten — und entwickelst es weiter, statt es nur zu verwalten. Du überträgst das System in Content: Social, Publikationen, Whitepaper, Präsentationen, Recruiting-Material. Das System ist erst fertig, wenn andere im Unternehmen damit arbeiten können, ohne dich zu fragen. Du setzt die visuellen Systeme der weiteren Marken auf, die bei Vogel entstehen. Dein Maßstab: Wer drei unserer Touchpoints nebeneinander sieht, erkennt sie ohne Logo als Vogel. Gestaltung über alle Medien Print: Publikationen, Geschäftsausstattung, Mandantenkommunikation, Kampagnenmotive — von der ersten Skizze bis zur Druckfreigabe in deiner Hand. Webdesign: Du gestaltest vogel-beratung.com und die dazugehörigen Seiten weiter, im direkten Austausch mit unserem Webentwickler. Darüber hinaus verantwortest du das Webdesign für alle Standorte und Gesellschaften der Vogel-Gruppe. Eventdesign und räumliche Gestaltung: Standorte, Bühnen, eigene Veranstaltungsformate, Messeauftritte. Du gestaltest, wie Vogel sich anfühlt, wenn man im Raum steht. Experience Design: Du denkst den Weg von Mandanten und Bewerbern als gestaltete Abfolge, nicht als Sammlung einzelner Assets. Kreativ-Steuerung, Partner und Nachwuchs Du steuerst Agenturen, Kreativpartner, Fotografen und Freelancer — Briefing, Auswahl, Qualitätsurteil, Freigabe. Zugeliefert wird Kapazität, die Handschrift bleibt deine. Du steuerst Motion Design von der Konzeption bis zur Abnahme und stellst sicher, dass Bewegtbild aus demselben System kommt wie alles andere. Du leitest unsere Design-Praktikanten und Berufseinsteiger fachlich an, gibst Feedback am Handwerk und baust darauf perspektivisch dein eigenes Team auf. Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt — wer vorankommen will, weil er gut ist, findet hier den Raum dafür, ohne politische Tarnung und ohne Konsens-Theater. Deine Perspektiven Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast: Du hast das visuelle System ausgebaut — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache und Komponenten sind erkennbar weiterentwickelt, nicht nur inventarisiert. Du hast vogel-beratung.com überarbeitet, die neuen Seiten sind live. Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für alle Designthemen im Unternehmen — Anfragen laufen bei dir zusammen, statt bei Externen zu landen. Du lieferst konstanten Output an Assets über alle Kanäle, ohne dass Themen liegen bleiben. Die Marke beginnt, deine Handschrift zu tragen. Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast: Das Designsystem ist in Figma so aufgesetzt, dass Content-, Growth- und Recruiting-Themen ohne dich sauber daraus produzieren. Die täglichen Assets aus dem Beratungsalltag — Präsentationen, Slides, Mandantenunterlagen — entstehen automatisiert per KI auf Basis deines Designsystems. Dass das trägt, hängt an sauberer Dokumentation und einem belastbaren technischen Setup: beides liegt bei dir. Das Designsystem und die Assets aller Sub-Marken der Vogel-Gruppe sind ausgebaut und angewendet — jede Marke hat ein eigenes visuelles Fundament, das erkennbar aus derselben Logik kommt. Dein Partner-Setup steht: ausgewählte Agenturen und Kreativpartner, klare Briefing-Standards, Qualitätsurteil bei dir. Motion Design läuft als eigener Produktionsstrang unter deiner Steuerung. Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast: Vogel ist visuell unverwechselbar — im Markt zuordenbar, ohne dass ein Logo nötig ist. Eine neue Marke setzt du visuell in Wochen auf, nicht in Quartalen — das System trägt das, ohne dass du jedes Asset selbst baust. Du hast mindestens einen Junior-Designer eingestellt, eingearbeitet und auf ein Niveau gebracht, auf dem er eigene Strecken trägt. Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt: Der nächste Schritt ist die fachliche Führung von Design und Brand über alle Marken hinweg (IC-Karriere) — das setzt ein visuelles System voraus, das ohne dich trägt, nicht nur zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Wenn du das Team mit aufbaust und führen willst, öffnet sich zusätzlich die Führungslaufbahn. Wir kennen keinen Automatismus „mehr Erfahrung gleich höhere Stufe". Das bringst du mit Erfahrung & Track Record Du hast ein Portfolio auf höchstem Niveau — Grafikdesign, Typografie, Branding-Systeme, visuelles Storytelling. Das Portfolio entscheidet, nicht der Lebenslauf. Du hast in einem professionellen Setup produziert: Agentur mit Design- oder Branding-Fokus, eigenes Studio, oder Inhouse bei einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Berufsjahre sind für uns ein Indiz, kein Kriterium — wir entscheiden an Arbeiten und an Umsetzungsfähigkeit. Du hast Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, visuelle Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares studiert — oder du hast dir das Handwerk selbst beigebracht und kannst das mit Arbeiten belegen, die den Abschluss ersetzen. Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber visuelles Urteil und Umsetzungstiefe mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Konkret: Designer aus einem kleinen Studio ohne große Namen, dessen Arbeiten besser sind als das, was große Agenturen abliefern; Art Director aus einem Feld weit weg von B2B — Mode, Kultur, Gastronomie, Musik — mit systemischem Denken; Architekt oder Szenograf mit ausgeprägtem Gespür für Typografie und Fläche; Autodidakt mit eigenem Magazin, Label oder Projekt, das visuell trägt. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala: das untere Ende steht für den Einstieg direkt nach Studium oder Ausbildung mit überzeugender Mappe, das obere Ende für gestalterische Tiefe im Schwerpunkt, ein System, das ohne dich trägt, und einen erkennbaren Methodenbeitrag — nicht für Führungsspanne. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau — die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen . Skills & Arbeitsweise Du beherrschst die Adobe Creative Cloud auf Produktionsniveau — InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop — und Figma als Systemwerkzeug. Du kannst Webdesign so übergeben, dass es umsetzbar ist. Ein Grundverständnis von HTML und CSS hilft, ist aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast Motion-Grundlagen — genug, um zu briefen, zu steuern und Ergebnisse zu beurteilen. Mehr ist willkommen. Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug — Bildgenerierung, Varianten-Exploration, Retusche, schnelles Durchspielen von Layout-Richtungen. Du denkst ein Designsystem so, dass eine KI verlässlich daraus produzieren kann. Repetitive Aufgaben sind dir ein Reiz zur Automatisierung, kein Schicksal. Du produzierst in kurzen Zyklen und zeigst früh Unfertiges. Lange Abstimmungsschleifen und Präsentations-Choreografie brauchst du nicht. Mindset & Persönlichkeit Du hast Geschmack und erkennst, wann etwas gut ist, ohne dass jemand dir Kriterien vorgibt — und du kannst deine Entscheidung trotzdem begründen, statt dich hinter Geschmack zu verstecken. Du hältst eine gestalterische Position, wenn du überzeugt bist, und lässt sie fallen, wenn das Gegenargument besser ist. Du willst mit Menschen arbeiten, die Design verstehen und nicht erst überzeugt werden müssen, dass es zählt. Die Feedback-Runden gehen hier über die Sache, nicht über Geschmackspolitik. Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen — nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört. generative AI assistants to accelerate vulnerability triage, code analysis, or remediation guidance.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> AI APIs into cybersecurity workflows and automation pipelines.</li> <li>Hands on experience with Infrastructure pentesting tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision logique d’excellence de service.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit/parlé) pour défendre un point de vue et communiquer efficacement.</p> </li> <li> <p>Capacité à construire des title: Business Development Representative - Marché Français
description: À propos du poste En tant que Business Development Representative chez Amenitiz, vous prenez en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact de prospection jusqu'à la signature du contrat. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste centré uniquement sur la prise de rendez-vous. Vous prospectez, réalisez des démonstrations, traitez les objections et concluez les ventes, tout en gérant votre pipeline et votre contribution au chiffre d'affaires de bout en bout. Nos clients sont des hôteliers indépendants partout en Europe : des établissements familiaux, des hôtels-boutiques et de petites chaînes hôtelières insuffisamment servis par des solutions technologiques conçues pour les grands groupes. Avec plus de 15 000 clients et une note de satisfaction de 4,8/5, notre produit bénéficie d'une forte reconnaissance sur le marché. Vous commercialiserez une solution qui a un impact concret et mesurable sur le quotidien de ses utilisateurs, tout en étant pleinement responsable de l'ensemble du processus qui leur permet d'y accéder. (Ce rôle est basé à Lyon, en France) Votre mission Prospection et génération de pipeline Identifiez et contactez de nouveaux clients potentiels par téléphone, e-mail et chat. Maintenez un niveau d'activité élevé et construisez un pipeline commercial solide à partir de zéro. Vous êtes responsable de l'ensemble de votre activité de prospection. Découverte des besoins et qualification Comprenez l'organisation actuelle de chaque prospect, ses problématiques et ses besoins opérationnels. Identifiez rapidement les opportunités pertinentes et positionnez Amenitiz de manière précise et adaptée à leur situation. Démonstrations produit Animez des démonstrations structurées et personnalisées qui établissent un lien direct entre les fonctionnalités du produit et les enjeux métier du prospect. Rendez la prise de décision simple et évidente. Gestion des objections et closing Traitez avec assurance les hésitations, les comparaisons avec la concurrence et les objections liées au timing. Créez un sentiment d'urgence lorsque cela est pertinent et sachez demander la signature. Gestion du pipeline Maintenez HubSpot à jour et garantissez la fiabilité des données. Réalisez des prévisions précises et assurez un suivi rigoureux de chaque opportunité. Collaboration Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables commerciaux et vos collègues afin d'améliorer en continu votre approche. Partagez les retours du marché, les objections récurrentes et les informations concurrentielles pour contribuer à la performance collective. À propos de vous Vous disposez de 2 à 4 ans d'expérience dans une fonction commerciale (SDR, Account Executive ou poste en cycle de vente complet). Vous êtes de langue maternelle française, italienne, espagnole ou portugaise, et possédez un excellent niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Vous êtes à l'aise pour alterner entre des phases de prospection intensive et des phases de closing au cours d'une même semaine. Vous assumez l'entière responsabilité de votre pipeline et de vos résultats, au-delà des simples indicateurs d'activité. Une expérience en SaaS, dans la technologie appliquée à l'hôtellerie ou en startup constitue un atout. La maîtrise de HubSpot ou d'un CRM similaire est appréciée. Des stock-options avec un calendrier d'acquisition progressif. Une couverture santé complète. Un accès anticipé à votre salaire, sans attendre la fin du mois. Un parcours de carrière structuré, avec des critères d'évolution clairement définis à chaque niveau. Des avantages flexibles permettant d'optimiser vos dépenses liées aux repas, à la garde d'enfants, aux transports et à la formation. title: Category Manager ( CDD de remplacement temporaire )
description: Le groupe Lovehoney est le leader mondial du bien-être sexuel. Cross-sell & merchandising produit → Définir et paramétrer les associations de cross-sell et d'upsell sur les fiches produit → Mettre en place des sélections de produits complémentaires pour maximiser le panier moyen → Remplir l'ensemble des main catégories et veiller à la cohérence du fil d'Ariane et de l'arborescence du site → Analyser la performance des cross-sell et ajuster les recommandations produit → Collaborer avec l'E-Merchandising Manager sur le tri et la mise en avant des produits associés Profil recherché Compétences techniques → Maîtrise de Magento 2 (thème Hyvä) ou autre CMS — compétence indispensable → Excellente maîtrise rédactionnelle en français, sens du storytelling produit → Bonne compréhension des logiques de cross-sell et de merchandising produit → Anglais professionnel indispensable (échanges réguliers avec les équipes groupe) → Solides bases en SEO (recherche de mots-clés, bonnes pratiques on-page) → Orienté(e) résultats : chaque action doit être mesurée et évaluée à l'aune de son impact sur la performance Compétences comportementales → Rigueur, sens du détail et respect des délais de production → Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main rapidement un nouvel outil (Magento) → Aisance dans le travail transverse (E-Merchandising Manager, SEO, CRO) → Curiosité pour les enjeux e-commerce et data Avantages chez Lovehoney Group France Café et boissons à disposition Fruits disponibles chaque semaine Petit-déjeuner chaque premier lundi du mois OpenUp : plateforme gratuite dédiée au bien-être et à la santé mentale Salle de jeux avec baby-foot, tennis de table et fléchettes Flexibilité concernant les horaires de travail et les congés payés Télétravail (6 jours par mois) Rattrapage des jours fériés tombant en weekend Code promotionnel interne Conditions du poste Dans le cadre du remplacement temporaire d’un salarié absent, nous proposons un CDD de remplacement jusqu'au 17 octobre 2026. title: People Partner Lead, Germany & Sweden
description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Why this role exists You’ll help build Neko’s clinical organisation in Germany from the ground up, and then lead the people strategy that helps it scale. Neko’s clinics are where our mission comes to life. The experience members have is shaped by the teams behind it, making the organisation itself one of the most important products we build. In Germany, this organisation doesn’t exist yet. Before the first clinic opens, you’ll help define clinical roles, workforce planning, compensation, and the employee experience that attracts exceptional talent. Then, as clinics launch and grow, you’ll partner with leaders to ensure those teams perform, develop, and scale successfully. This is a rare opportunity to build an organisation from day one – and to shape what it becomes as Neko brings prevention-first healthcare to another market. Phase one: build the foundation, pre-launch Ensure the German employment framework is appropriately set up with legal, external counsel, key internal teams, like People Ops and Workforce Planning – contracts, working-time and rostering models, pay structures, policies, payroll and people systems Design the clinic organisation from a blank sheet, and a staffing model sized to Neko’s ambition for the market rather than to the first clinic Own the launch workforce plan, the cover and contracting model, and reward in a German context – pay, pension, equity Build a German clinical employer proposition from zero with TA, and a playbook the next market can reuse Build for German employment structures from day one Design workforce policies (scheduling, pay, performance) with German labor law and employee representation requirements in mind from the start Work with legal counsel to determine the right structure for German clinic operations Ensure people systems and tools are built to comply with German labor regulations Phase two: run clinical people strategy live Be the day-to-day People partner across German clinical leadership, from senior operations and medical leaders through to frontline clinic managers Spend real time in clinics, and read what members experience there as signal about how teams are resourced, structured and led – spotting strain, inconsistency or risk early, because it usually shows up in the clinic room before it shows up in the data Coach clinic leaders through hiring, performance and the conversations that are hard but important – and build the leadership capability and multi-way feedback culture that keep employee relations issues from piling up, while supporting teams and leaders through the ones that do Support first-time clinic managers as they build confidence, capability and steady leadership habits Hold the staffing model against the growth plan: German absence, leave and part-time realities, the clinical qualification and mobility pipeline, and honesty when the plan and the labour market disagree Turn central People programmes into clinic-ready practice, and call out where a centralised approach misses frontline reality Revisit what you built pre-launch as clinics run, and put data and AI to work in how the People agenda actually operates – sharper decisions, less manual effort, more time on the judgement calls Take change from decision to genuine adoption, bringing clinic teams with you without pausing delivery to do it Beyond Germany Help drive the global People Partner team’s clinical strategy rather than just feed into it Bring the German clinical reality into that team's agenda, so decisions made at scale hold up on the ground Support the wider European market as it grows, and other markets as needed What you bring 8+ years as a senior People or HR Business Partner leader, across senior levels of leadership and frontline leaders of larger teams A builder's mindset – comfortable title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Werkstudent
description: DEINE ROLLE Du bist auf Instagram, LinkedIn & Co. zu Hause, hast ein gutes Gespür für Content und kannst selbst starke Posts, Reels und Stories produzieren? Du interessierst dich außerdem für Wirtschaft, Investments und die Welt rund um Vermögen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Als Social Media Manager (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, unsere Social-Media-Kanäle weiterzuentwickeln – von der ersten Content-Idee über die Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Content-, Brand- und Podcast-Team zusammen und bringst deine eigenen Ideen und dein Gespür für guten Social Content ein. Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate. Ob Social Posts, Reels, Podcast-Clips oder Event-Content: Du hilfst uns dabei, komplexe Finanz- und Investmentthemen verständlich, relevant und visuell stark für Social Media aufzubereiten. Was machst du dabei konkret? Social Media & Planung: Du betreust unsere Kanäle auf Instagram, LinkedIn und Facebook und planst gemeinsam mit dem Team, welche Themen und Formate wann und wo stattfinden. Content Creation: Du entwickelst Posts, Carousels, Reels und Stories von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Gleichzeitig machst du aus bestehenden Inhalten wie Magazinartikeln, Marktkommentaren, Interviews, Events oder Expertengesprächen eigenständigen Social Content – von starken Hooks und Captions bis zu Recaps und Key Takeaways. Podcast & Video: Du unterstützt bei der Produktion von That’s Smart Money und entwickelst aus unseren Gesprächen relevante Clips und Short-Form-Content. Dabei arbeitest du unter anderem mit Riverside und unseren Video-Tools. Trends & neue Ideen: Du beobachtest, welche Formate und Mechaniken auf Social Media funktionieren, und überlegst, was davon zu LIQID passt. Gute Ideen sollst du bei uns nicht nur vorschlagen, sondern auch ausprobieren können. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Du verstehst Social Media und hast bereits selbst Content gemacht: Ob für einen eigenen Account, ein Projekt, dein Studium oder ein Unternehmen, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, dass du ein gutes Gespür dafür hast, was auf Social Media funktioniert. Du kannst Geschichten erzählen und richtig gut schreiben: Du erkennst den interessanten Gedanken in einem Thema, findest einen starken Einstieg und kannst auch komplexere Inhalte verständlich und präzise auf den Punkt bringen. Du hast ein gutes visuelles Gespür und Lust auf Produktion: Fotografie, Typografie, Layout und Video interessieren dich und du setzt Content gerne selbst um. Erfahrung mit Riverside, CapCut, Premiere oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Du packst selbst an: Du arbeitest eigenständig und zuverlässig, bringst Ideen mit und hast Lust, Verantwortung für eigene Themen und Formate zu übernehmen. Du bist neugierig auf Finanzthemen: Du musst noch kein Investment-Profi sein. Aber Wirtschaft, Märkte und Investments interessieren dich und du hast Lust, dich auch in komplexere Themen einzuarbeiten. Du arbeitest gerne im Team: Du hast Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Content, Brand, Podcast und anderen Bereichen aus einer guten Idee richtig guten Content zu machen. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte – und geben dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, LIQID und das Team kennenzulernen. Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit unserer Social Media Managerin Verena: Wir tauschen uns darüber aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Kleine praktische Aufgabe: Du bekommst eine Aufgabe, die sich an typischen Themen aus deinem zukünftigen Arbeitsalltag orientiert. So sehen wir, wie du Content denkst und umsetzt – und du bekommst einen konkreten Eindruck von der Rolle. Gespräch mit unserer Hiring Managerin Lenika & Team: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle ein, sprechen über deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und geben dir einen Einblick in unsere Content- und Social-Media-Arbeit. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt. title: Growth Operations
description: About Uplane (YC F25) Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building an AI marketing operating system. title: (Senior) Marketing Manager
description: Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry? We are Emma – The Sleep Company . Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. Ready to awaken your best with us? About The Role We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to drive online revenue growth for Emma's EU Ecommerce team. You will be responsible for owning paid channels campaigns end to end, so that every euro invested delivers a measurable return. You'll work closely with key stakeholders, ranging from Global Performance Marketing and Creative Marketing to Brand Marketing and the different EU Ecommerce country teams. What You'll Do Own paid campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Affiliates, Influencer, CRM and TV (linear and CTV), from strategy through execution to continuous optimization. Run A/B tests across creatives, audiences and landing pages, and turn the results into repeatable playbooks that raise performance across your channels and your market. Stay ahead of platform changes, algorithm updates and market trends, and proactively bring new tools, tactics and opportunities to the team. Define and drive performance targets such as ROAS, CPA and conversion rate, and turn data from attribution tools and in-house dashboards into clear strategic decisions. Own your revenue target and deliver local, regional or global projects on time, becoming the go-to expert for the channels you own. Collaborate with global performance and creative teams on ad messaging, budget allocation and channel mix to maximize return on every euro invested. Partner with Sales to drive commercial performance across products and categories in your market, aligning campaign plans with commercial priorities. Who We're Looking For You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Finance, Business Administration or Engineering, which gives you a solid base for data-driven decisions. You have 3+ years of relevant in-house experience in B2C Ecommerce, ideally in FMCG, consumer goods or online services, with ownership of paid performance channels. You bring strong analytical skills and a strategic understanding of paid channels, turning performance data into decisions that grow revenue and improve ROAS. You have project management experience, having delivered local, regional or global projects on time while aligning multiple stakeholders along the way. You are proactive and self-reflective: you bring ideas instead of waiting for tasks, take feedback well and own your channels with autonomy. title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description: Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. What We Want to Achieve Together In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. Meet the team in the office. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team! How to Apply Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence? title: (Senior) SEO Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Was erwartet dich? Du liebst Rankingfaktoren, Keyword-Recherchen und die Suche nach Fehlern und Potenzialen – und verstehst, wie Suchmaschinen und KI-gestützte Suche funktionieren? This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability. What you'll do Architecture Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. No need to train them. Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms This role is a great fit if… You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. title: Head of Sales @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together. Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia. Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts. Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country. Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check. Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers. 📈 How you will be measured First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed. 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed. 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped. 🤩 This job is your dream job if: You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2 You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it 🙅 This job is not for you if: You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group What we offer A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea 🧭 Our recruitment process A first call to get to know each other. A deep dive into two deals you closed. A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders. A conversation with the founders. Reference checks, with your consent. Offer. We answer after each step. Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
