title: Senior Process Engieer
description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs ● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently. ● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation. ● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews, ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather than after installation. ● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process parameters of newly commissioned systems. Nice-to-have's: Vendor & EPC Coordination ● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners and equipment suppliers. ● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering documentation. ● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process. ● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability. ● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and equipment vendors throughout project execution. Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and real plant data. ● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or a related technical field. ● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical, hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing is highly preferred. ● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs, mass/energy balances and equipment sizing. ● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data into engineering models and decisions. ● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation, hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable. ● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical assumptions. ● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of industrial equipment or plants. ● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA. ● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering documentation and the actual plant. ● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering, Operations, suppliers and EPC partners. ● Fluent English; German is a plus. Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward increasingly larger and more standardized plants. The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts. title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
description: THE JOB Reading this to the end is worth it. The Company: Why mute-labs? mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back. We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you. Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires. The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing. Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it. Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script. Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on. Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once. A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one. A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers. Is This You? The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you. Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here. Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread. Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role. Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language. Our Hiring Process We keep this fast and honest, on both sides. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here. ABOUT US mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart: We are "no tech" : we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need. We have no investors , and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one. We are on a steep growth curve , measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake. We are not building toward an exit . We are building a company meant to last for generations. Skip the Queue Told you it was worth reading to the end. We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly. +49 15888 279908 If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could. title: Senior Systems Engineer - Application Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available locations: <span class="collapsed-field-text">Lisbon, Portugal or London, UK. </span>This role requires two days in office, it is not a fully remote role.</strong></span></h2> <h2>About The Team</h2> <p>Application Security is responsible for Cloudflare’s fast-growing security product portfolio including WAF, Page Shield, Web Asset Management and API Shield. Being part of Cloudflare means working at internet scale and we are uniquely positioned to tackle challenging problems related to being connected to more networks, websites and customers than any other provider worldwide. Working at great scale by default (to an extent not offered by most other employers in big tech) means pushing boundaries well beyond what commodity solutions like Nginx and Kafka provide out of the box. You’ll be working with custom components that have been created in an engineering-driven and pragmatic way - our code is well-tested and documented and uses modern ecosystems like Go and Rust. This gives you confidence that you will spend your time having an impact and not firefighting!</p> <p>You’d be joining a high-profile part of the business that can really accelerate and support your career. Cloudflare has a strong track record of growing in a thoughtful way and hires carefully so we’re confident that you will enjoy working with your colleagues here!</p> <h2>About You</h2> <p><strong>You must have at least 5 years of professional experience working hands-on as a software developer</strong>. We require proficiency with at least one of Go or Rust, plus exposure to devops tooling like but not limited to Kubernetes, Salt, Kafka or Systemd. Strong Linux / Unix fundamentals will be very helpful. You must have experience working with distributed systems at scale. Experience with cyber security is preferred but not essential.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s culture is busy and multifaceted, and people who succeed here are persistent, have a can-do attitude and a genuine willingness to assume good faith in others. This last quality in particular requires them to be empathetic and emotionally intelligent, so you’re someone willing to take responsibility for the culture and environment that you create around you.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Design systems and write code following bleeding edge industry best practices and help others on the team do the same. Review RFCs, technical specifications and code.</li> <li>Deploy and maintain live software-based services at scale (up to 100m requests / second, 1m customers). Take regular shifts as part of the team’s On Call rota.</li> <li>Support and grow other Engineers through knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Keep up to date with trends in detecting current and emerging security risks to web applications and provide input on how these impact Cloudflare’s products.</li> <li>Work with Engineers and Product Managers outside your immediate team in communicating our roadmap and getting things done.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>Cloudflare offers a positive and stimulating place to work, where you can enjoy friendly relationships with your colleagues and the freedom to have real impact on our products and customers. While the work is demanding, the company is unusual in offering an unlimited leave policy. This is not a “race to the bottom” or proxy for reducing the amount of leave taken; leaders around the company model the behaviour of always taking the time off that they need.</p> <p>In addition to a competitive base salary, Cloudflare offers an equity program with stock grants on joining and regular refreshers linked to performance. And in common with other big tech companies, we offer medical and dental insurance, mental health support, a tax efficient defined contributions pension plan and life insurance.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Senior Product Manager, CRM - MONOPOLY GO!
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Senior Product Manager, CRM</strong> to join our MONOPOLY GO! game team in our Barcelona studio on a hybrid basis (3X in office), or remotely within the UK.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. </p> <p>MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Product Manager to shape how Monopoly GO! connects with players throughout their journey, solving complex product challenges and creating communication experiences that are more relevant, timely, and valuable. </p> <p>As Senior Product Manager for CRM, you’ll own the vision and roadmap for the capabilities, tools, and experiences that power communication throughout the player journey. You’ll identify player and business needs, translate them into product opportunities, and lead cross-functional teams to discover, build, and continuously improve scalable CRM solutions for a leading live-service mobile game.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><strong>Product Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Own and lead the CRM product roadmap and strategy across player-facing experiences and internal tooling, translating player, business, behavioural, and market insights into strategic priorities</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, reactivation, and player value, while shaping the future of CRM across push, email, in-game messaging, Live Activities, and emerging channels</li> <li>Champion relevant, contextual, personalised, and player-first communication experiences while serving as a senior product voice and CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><strong>Roadmap, Discovery and Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Lead discovery and ideation to identify player needs, team pain points, and opportunities to evolve CRM, while leading a cross-functional product area with dedicated software engineering resources</li> <li>Provide clear product direction, priorities, requirements, and success criteria to guide execution, and own delivery outcomes from discovery and prioritisation through development, launch, measurement, and iteration</li> <li>Evolve CRM capabilities including personalisation, automation, segmentation, decisioning, orchestration, and dynamic content</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><strong>Performance and Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Partner with the analytics team to monitor and report on program effectiveness, using data-driven insights to recommend continuous improvement and keep players at the heart of every decision</li> <li>Lead structured testing strategies across A/B testing, cadence, segmentation, and channel mix, while championing a strong test-and-learn culture</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in Product Management or a related product discipline</li> <li>Product experience in gaming is strongly preferred; experience in entertainment or mobile apps is also relevant</li> <li>Strong understanding of player lifecycle and contact strategy</li> <li>Analytical mindset and confidence using data to identify opportunities and guide decisions</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and comfort working in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>A player-first mindset and a drive to keep improving product and communication strategies</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with Braze or a similar marketing automation platform</li> <li>Experience with tools such as Looker </li> <li>Experience with live-service, casual, or social games</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>. </p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. title: Graduate AI and Secure Technologies Engineer (2027 start)
description: <p><strong>Cambridge, UK</strong><br><strong>UK travel and occasional international travel</strong></p> <h3><strong>Introduction</strong></h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re looking for graduates who are excited by the opportunity to make emerging technologies secure, trustworthy and resilient. You’ll work on real-world engineering challenges across cyber security, artificial intelligence, embedded systems and connected technologies, supporting projects in areas including defence and security, industrial systems and critical national infrastructure.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll need to be curious, willing to learn and comfortable exploring unfamiliar technical problems. In return, we’ll provide the support, mentoring and hands-on experience you need to develop into a confident, well-rounded security engineer working on innovative deep technology.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re much more interested in the engineer you can become than the one you are now. We’ll give you the time, support and opportunities to build your security engineering skills and develop the confidence to contribute to challenging client projects. Curiosity, a careful and structured approach to problem solving, and enthusiasm for technology are more important than having experience in every area of cyber security.</p> <h2> </h2> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Overview</strong></h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Cambridge Consultants develops deep technology across sensing, communications, embedded systems, artificial intelligence and complex systems. Our Trusted AI and Secure Technologies team helps clients understand, design and demonstrate security and trustworthiness in emerging and connected technologies.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside engineers and specialists in electronics, firmware, software, RF, AI and data science, and systems engineering. Projects can span the full engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concepts and requirements through to implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our work includes cyber security, secure-by-design engineering, embedded and connected systems, industrial and critical infrastructure, defence and national security, edge AI, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"> </p> <h3><strong>Your responsibilities</strong></h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll work on real client assignments with support and guidance from experienced engineers. You’ll have opportunities to contribute across different stages of the engineering lifecycle and work alongside specialists from across Cambridge Consultants.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You may contribute to projects at different stages of the engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concept development and requirements through to architecture, implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll also have opportunities to interact directly with clients, including requirements discussions, technical workshops, progress updates and delivery, with support from experienced engineers where appropriate.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"> </p> <h3><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Contributing to threat modelling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments.</li> <li>Helping to identify security requirements and develop secure-by-design system architectures.</li> <li>Supporting vulnerability assessments and security testing, including helping to scope testing activities and track remediation.</li> <li>Investigating vulnerabilities and helping teams understand and address security risks.</li> <li>Contributing to security cases, assurance activities and technical documentation.</li> <li>Analysing systems, software and technical designs to identify potential security weaknesses.</li> <li>Developing prototypes, analysis tools or other technical solutions to investigate security problems.</li> <li>Working with multidisciplinary teams to understand the interaction between security, functionality, safety and system performance.</li> <li>Communicating technical findings clearly to engineers, project teams and customers.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>Domains and project types</strong></h5> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You could work across a range of applications and technologies, including:</p> <ul data-spread="false"> <li><strong>Critical national infrastructure:</strong> energy, transport, communications and utilities.</li> <li><strong>Industrial systems:</strong> ICS, SCADA, OT and industrial IoT.</li> <li><strong>Defence and national security:</strong> secure systems and technologies supporting demanding operational environments.</li> <li><strong>Emerging technologies:</strong> AI assurance, sensing, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you can bring</strong></h3> <h5><strong>The below is essential</strong></h5> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>An excellent degree or PhD in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.</li> <li>12 months industrial experience, for example through a placement year or relevant postgraduate experience.</li> <li>A good understanding of fundamental engineering, computing or security principles.</li> <li>Practical experience through university, industrial placement, work experience, research or personal projects in at least one or more relevant areas, such as:</li> </ul> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>cyber/security engineering</li> <li>software or application development</li> <li>embedded systems</li> <li>computer or network systems</li> <li>electronics or hardware security</li> <li>AI or data science</li> <li>systems engineering</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>The ability to understand and analyse technical systems and identify risks or weaknesses.</li> <li>Some familiarity with security concepts such as authentication, authorisation, cryptography, key management, secure boot, network security and secure development.</li> <li>The ability to read and understand code in languages such as C, C++, Python or Java.</li> <li>Enthusiasm for learning and developing new technical skills.</li> <li>A careful and structured approach to problem solving.</li> <li>Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.</li> </ul> <h5><strong>The below is advantageous, but isn’t essential</strong></h5> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Familiarity with threat-modelling approaches such as STRIDE or MITRE ATT&CK.</li> <li>Knowledge of secure development practices and frameworks such as OWASP or CWE.</li> <li>Experience with embedded platforms, MCUs, RTOS, TPMs or TrustZone.</li> <li>Familiarity with industrial protocols and standards such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA or IEC 62443.</li> <li>Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Wireshark or firmware-analysis tools.</li> <li>An understanding of cloud security.</li> <li>Experience considering security alongside safety or other system-level requirements.</li> <li>Security research, university projects, technical projects or open-source contributions.</li> <li>Industry certifications or formal security training.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check level security clearance ( <a href="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant">https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant</a> ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.</p> <p>Along with your CV, please describe why you are attracted to this position, what you feel you offer Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of. We are especially interested to hear about any projects you have done, for a hobby, for work or for university. </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Solutions Engineer (EMEA Region)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW4324591 BCX8" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW4324591 BCX8">As a leader in Lawful and Location Intelligence, SS8 helps make societies safer. Our commitment is to extract, analyze, and visualize the critical intelligence that gives law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and emergency services the real-time insights that help save lives. Our high performance, flexible, and future-proof solutions also enable mobile network operators to achieve regulatory compliance with minimum disruption, time, and cost. SS8 is trusted by the largest government agencies, communications providers, and systems integrators globally.</span></span></p></div><p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a customer-facing Senior Solutions Engineer to support sales of SS8’s portfolio across Law Enforcement (LEA), Intelligence Community (IC), and Communications Service Providers (CSPs) primarily in the UK, and across the EMEA region. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise and strategic sales—translating complex mission needs into deployable, scalable solutions.</p> <p>As a highly skilled Senior Solutions Engineer, you will leverage your expertise to deliver pre-sales engineering support as a subject matter expert. This role involves extensive engagement with customers and partners, ensuring the highest technical and professional standards while upholding SS8’s customer-first approach. You will serve as the primary technical representative to customers, articulating SS8’s solution capabilities and playing a key role in influencing customer decisions and successful solution adoption.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with sales, product, and delivery teams to drive technical wins, shape customer architectures, and ensure SS8 solutions align with operational and compliance requirements.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Pre-Sales & Solution Engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer mission requirements across lawful intercept, location intelligence, and data analytics.</li> <li>Represent SS8 and its partner ecosystem in designing and delivering end-to-end solutions tailored to customer and prospect requirements spanning telecom networks, data collection, mediation, analytics, and visualization platforms.</li> <li>Own the technical sales cycle: architecture, solution positioning, demos, POCs, and RFP/RFI responses with innovative and differentiated approaches.</li> <li>Translate vague “we need intel” asks into concrete system designs (and push back when needed).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted technical advisor to LEA, IC, and telecom stakeholders.</li> <li>Present complex solutions clearly to both engineers and non-technical decision-makers.</li> <li>Support customer workshops, technical deep dives, and executive briefings.</li> <li>Bridge the gap between operational users and IT/network teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Architecture & Integration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop high-level and detailed architectures integrating SS8 solutions into existing customer environments.</li> <li>Ensure alignment with telecom standards, lawful intercept frameworks, and regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Collaborate with delivery teams to ensure smooth transition from design to implementation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sales Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with account teams to develop winning strategies for new and existing opportunities.</li> <li>Own creation of proposals, quotes, SOWs, and technical documentation.</li> <li>Support competitive positioning and articulate differentiators.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Product & Feedback Loop</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide structured feedback to product management on emerging trends, customer challenges, requirements analysis and field-driven insights based on field experience.</li> <li>Influence product direction with real-world use cases and customer pain points.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Required Experience & Qualifications</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years in solution and systems engineering, sales engineering, network engineering, or solution architecture.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to design and size high-capacity, high-performance, mission-critical systems.</li> <li>Strong understanding of telecom network architectures and signaling protocols:</li> <ul> <li>3G, 4G LTE/EPC, and 5G Core</li> <li>IMS, VoLTE, VoIP</li> <li>IP networking (routing, switching, protocols)</li> </ul> <li>Experience with lawful intercept frameworks and systems.</li> <li>Solid understanding of data flows, packet capture, and network-based data collection.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Domain Knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting or working with:</li> <ul> <li>Law Enforcement Agencies (LEA)</li> <li>Intelligence Community (IC)</li> <li>Telecommunications Service Providers (CSPs)</li> </ul> <li>Exposure to OSINT, location intelligence, or analytics platforms is a strong plus.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with virtualization and/or cloud-native description: Für unsere Kunden suchen wir jemanden, der Print, Web und Social Media gestaltet und mit den Leuten spricht, für die es gemacht ist. Wer ist FAKT.? Oft aus Fotos, die wir selbst beim Kunden gemacht haben, nicht aus der Stockdatenbank. Und du betreust Kunden. Abstimmungen, Korrekturschleifen, Rückfragen. Und du merkst, wenn etwas nicht stimmt, bevor der Kunde es merkt. Du telefonierst nicht ungern. Kunden sollen dich anrufen können, ohne dass einer von uns übersetzen muss. Du warst eine Weile raus? Wir arbeiten dich in das ein, was neu ist, und du kannst gern in Teilzeit wieder einsteigen. Benefits Was du bekommst 30 Tage Urlaub. Gleitzeit. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, ganz wie es zu dir passt, und Arbeitszeiten, die wir gemeinsam planbar machen. Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Firmenkreditkarte für Tools, Lizenzen und Schriften, die du brauchst. Jede Woche frisches Obst. Getränke kalt und warm frei. Betriebsfeiern und gesellige Abende. Gearbeitet wird bei uns in Aurich, in der Fockenbollwerkstraße. Wir sind ein Team, das am selben Tisch sitzt, deshalb ist diese Stelle vor Ort. Was uns weniger interessiert Abschlussnote und lückenloser Lebenslauf. Zeig uns lieber drei Arbeiten und erzähl uns, warum du sie so gemacht hast. Schick uns gerne dein Portfolio oder ein paar Links. title: Senior Power Electronics Engineer
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role Power electronics are the bottleneck on every next-generation UAS airframe we build: motor controllers, gate drivers, and DC-DC stages are what define flight time, payload, thermal envelope, and field reliability. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision. EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads. Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns. Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation. Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary. Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Candidate Requirements MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent. 5+ years of hands-on R&D experience on motor drives, BLDC/PMSM controllers, or high-power-density power electronics. Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Karriere Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen. Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht. Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team. Deine Aufgaben Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-gestützten Softwarelösungen – von der ersten Idee bis in den stabilen Produktivbetrieb Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails Design und Umsetzung von LLM-Anwendungen: RAG-Pipelines, strukturierte Extraktion, Evaluation, Observability Integration von ML-Modellen, Foundation Models und datengetriebenen Services in bestehende oder neue Systeme – inklusive der APIs, Datenflüsse und Infrastruktur drumherum Hands-on-Entwicklung skalierbarer, wartbarer und performanter Anwendungen auf modernen Technologien und Cloud-Plattformen (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry o. ä.) Identifikation von KI-Use-Cases in Kundenprojekten – und die ehrliche Einschätzung, wann ein Agent die richtige Antwort ist und wann eine deterministische Lösung die bessere Agentic Coding im eigenen Arbeitsalltag: KI-Werkzeuge produktiv und verantwortungsvoll in Entwicklung, Review und Delivery einsetzen – und dem Team zeigen, wie es geht Technologische Beratung unserer Kunden bei Architektur-, Technologie- und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität durch Clean Code, Tests, Reviews und Best Practices Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres wachsenden KI-Kompetenzfelds – Themen setzen, Wissen ins Team tragen, Standards etablieren Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der modernen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Fullstack-Umfeld – du bist und bleibst Entwickler <3 Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und generativer KI in echten Projekten: Prompting, RAG, Embeddings/Vektor-Datenbanken, Function Calling, Fine-Tuning oder Agenten-Frameworks. Erfahrung oder ernsthaftes Interesse an Agentic Engineering – du hast schon einmal einen Agenten über den Demo-Status hinaus gebracht oder brennst darauf, es zu tun Solides Verständnis von ML-Grundlagen und Datenverarbeitung – du weißt, was ein Modell leisten kann und wo seine Grenzen liegen Cloud-Entwicklung mit AWS und/oder Azure, inklusive CI/CD, Containern und Infrastructure as Code Sicherer Umgang mit Clean Code, SOLID-Prinzipien und der Gestaltung sauberer Softwarearchitekturen Selbstständige, verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit stark ausgeprägten analytischen und konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten Die Fähigkeit, pragmatische Lösungen für komplexe Anforderungen zu entwickeln – und über den Tellerrand hinaus zu denken Hohe Motivation und Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung und für ein Technologiefeld, das sich monatlich neu erfindet Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) in Wort und Schrift, sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Nice to have: Da wir als Dienstleister mit unterschiedlichen Kunden und Projekten arbeiten, freuen wir uns über Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Frameworks Angular .NET NestJS Programmiersprachen C# TypeScript Python Infrastruktur & Cloud Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform und/oder CDK Du musst nicht alles davon mitbringen – wichtiger ist uns deine Senior-Erfahrung, deine Lernbereitschaft und deine Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Technologien und Projektumgebungen einzuarbeiten. Was bieten wir Dir? Einheit: AI Engineering Level: Senior Arbeitsvolumen: Vollzeit Einige unserer Benefits: Tech, Ownership & Impact Architektur mitgestalten: Du triffst technische Entscheidungen, setzt Engineering-Standards und übernimmst Verantwortung für langlebige Systemdesigns. Makers Lab: Neben Kundenprojekten entwickelst du interne Tools und Lösungen, die uns wirklich weiterbringen. Wenn eine Idee gut ist, setzten wir sie um. Wissen teilen : In Show-How-Sessions und Workshops steuert jeder was bei – egal ob Junior oder Senior. Gezielte Weiterbildungen kommen obendrauf. Echtes Mitspracherecht: Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns echte Entscheidungsfreiheit statt Micromanagement. Dein Setup, deine Wahl: Arbeite mit dem Setup, das zu dir passt – macOS oder Windows? Deine Entscheidung. Flexibilität & Gehalt Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Ob Early Bird oder Nachteule; du arbeitest dann, wenn du am produktivsten bist. Remote & Home-Office innerhalb Deutschlands: Du arbeitest dort, wo du am produktivsten bist. Workation innerhalb der EU: Temporär von einem anderen Ort aus arbeiten? Für uns selbstverständlich. Lunch geht auf uns: Über LunchIt erhältst du an jedem Arbeitstag 7,50 € Zuschuss für dein Mittagessen. Bezahlung: Deine Erfahrung wird überdurchschnittlich vergütet - ohne dass du dafür lange verhandeln musst. 30 Tage Urlaub: Genug Zeit, um wirklich abzuschalten - und flexible Planung, damit das auch klappt. Team-Kultur & Gaming Von LAN-Partys bis zu gemeinsamen Quartals-Events – wir erleben auch abseits des Codes echte Highlights. Gut versorgt durch den Tag. :) Ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit Snacks und einer großen Auswahl an Getränken steht jederzeit bereit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior/ Lead AI Consultant
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As a Senior/ Lead AI Consultant (known internally - Senior/ Lead Deployment Engineer), you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.</p> <p>This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. <strong>You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.</strong></p> <p><strong>The Work You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Initiate and Connect</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases</li> <li>Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria</li> <li>Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build & Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements</li> <li>Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights</li> <li>Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer</li> <li>Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot</li> <li>Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies</li> <li>Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact</li> <li>Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance</li> </ul> <p><strong> Rollout, Adoption, and Handover</strong></p> <ul> <li>Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption</li> <li>Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations</li> <li>Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value</li> <li>Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff</li> </ul> <p><strong>Domain & Industry Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals</li> <li>Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage</li> <li>Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era</strong></p> <ul> <li>You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually</li> <li>You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly</li> <li>You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers</li> <li>You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer</li> <li>You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Qualifications You Need</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 4-7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. </li> <li><strong>Platform skills: </strong>Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.</li> <li><strong>AI fluency: </strong>Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. title: Senior AI/ML Software Engineer
description: About Nabla We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine. Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day. We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows. Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere. This is a great time to join us! The best of AI at the service of healthcare Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare. Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership. Engineering at Nabla Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale. Your Team At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership. As an AI Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product. What you'll do As an AI/ML Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our engineering team and product. Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Meta, Google, and Microsoft, you will: Build agentic pipelines: chains of LLM-based agents that work together on complex clinical documentation tasks. Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care. Integrate LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others) into production features. Design prompts and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality, then iterate quickly based on results. Write clean, production-grade code and own your features end to end, from design to deployment and monitoring in a live healthcare setting. Work closely with product managers to turn model capabilities into reliable, scalable product features. To get a sense of the impact you’ll have: Nabla processes 300 billion tokens/month with LLMs. By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes , saving 125 hours of doctor time . Your DNA: The ideal candidate will bring strong software engineering skills and a practical, hands-on approach to building with LLMs. You have 3+ years writing production code, with solid skills in software design, testing, and system architecture. You’re proficient in one or more widely used back-end languages (Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, etc.). You’ve built features or products using LLM provider APIs, including prompting and evaluation. You don’t need to have trained or fine-tuned models yourself. You can turn a fuzzy product requirement into a working, testable pipeline. You have a passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients. You communicate clearly and effectively. Bonus: Experience building multi-agent systems or agent orchestration frameworks is a strong plus. Our Stack Kotlin for backend services LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and others) for the models themselves Agent orchestration frameworks for building chains of agents Prompt evaluation and testing tools to track output quality over time Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment Where you'll be based Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers) . Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year. Benefits Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work. Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla: Stock ownership 100% healthcare coverage Meal vouchers Public transportation costs covered at 50% Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time Life at Nabla When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed. We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes. We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts! If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application! Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link . Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Atlassian Consultant (m/w/d) - Cloud Migration im Banking
description: Welcome to TEAM XALT Wir sind XALT – Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner mit 100 % DevSecOps-DNA. Seit 2016 realisieren wir Enterprise-Projekte in den Bereichen ITSM, Social Intranets, Cloud-Infrastruktur und Identity Management und schaffen sichere, skalierbare und moderne Kollaborationsumgebungen – auch dort, wo Regulatorik und Informationssicherheit jedes Detail mitentscheiden. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen und große Enterprise-Organisationen in ganz Deutschland. Wir glauben an Freiheit statt Mikromanagement, an Zusammenarbeit statt Hierarchiedenken und an Wirkung statt Titel. Bei uns übernehmen Menschen Verantwortung, bringen ihre Ideen ein und gestalten sowohl Kundenlösungen als auch die Weiterentwicklung von XALT aktiv mit. Wenn du echte Verantwortung und spürbaren Impact in einer wachsenden Beratung suchst, wirst du dich bei uns wohlfühlen. Warum gerade jetzt Atlassian stellt seine Data-Center-Produkte ein. Für Banken heißt das: Jira, Confluence und Jira Service Management müssen in die Cloud – als IT-Auslagerung unter DORA, MaRisk und EBA-Leitlinien, die vor Revision und Aufsicht bestehen muss. Genau diese Projekte machen wir. Und dafür suchen wir Verstärkung. Aufgaben Als Atlassian Consultant begleitest du Banken und Finanzdienstleister von der Plattformstrategie bis zum Go-live in der Cloud. Du verbindest Beratungsstärke mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Heute sprichst du mit CIO und CISO über das Zielbild, morgen mit dem Auslagerungsmanagement über die Exit-Strategie – und übermorgen konfigurierst du selbst das Berechtigungsschema. Deine Aufgaben Plattformstrategie: Du analysierst gewachsene Atlassian-Landschaften und entwickelst Zielbilder – Cloud vs. Hybrid, Instanzschnitt, Mandantentrennung, Governance- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Roadmap. Regulatorisch saubere Migration: Du bereitest Migrationen so auf, dass Informationssicherheit, Auslagerungsmanagement, Compliance und Datenschutz sie freigeben können – inkl. Risikoanalyse, Exit-Strategie, DORA-Informationsregister, Prüfrechte und Subdienstleister. Security & Compliance in der Cloud: Du setzt EU-Datenresidenz, SSO/SCIM mit Atlassian Guard, Audit-Logging, Verschlüsselungskonzepte, Rollentrennung (SoD) und Berechtigungsrezertifizierung um. Migrationsplanung & -durchführung: Cloud-Readiness-Assessment, App-Analyse und -Bereinigung, Wellen- und Cutover-Planung, Migration mit JCMA/CCMA – im Takt von Change-Freeze-Zeiten und Vier-Augen-Prinzip der Bank. Prüfungsfeste Dokumentation: Migrationsprotokolle, Datenintegritätsnachweise und Berechtigungskonzepte für Revision und Aufsicht. Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du moderierst Workshops mit Entscheidern und Kontrollfunktionen und übersetzt technische Optionen in fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen. Best Practices: Du entwickelst unsere Migrationsplaybooks für regulierte Kunden weiter und machst das Team damit skalierbar. Qualifikation Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Atlassian-Beratung oder -Administration im Enterprise-Umfeld. Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit mindestens einer komplexen Server-/Data-Center-→-Cloud-Migration. Projekterfahrung im Banking bzw. in der Finanzbranche – oder in einem vergleichbar regulierten Umfeld. Solides Verständnis von DORA, MaRisk/BAIT, EBA-Leitlinien zu Auslagerungen und DSGVO. Du musst kein Jurist sein, aber die Fragen der Compliance-Abteilung beantworten können. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Jira, Confluence und Jira Service Management, idealerweise auch Atlassian Cloud Enterprise und Atlassian Guard. Hands-on-Mentalitä t: Du konfigurierst selbst und wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand anderes die Umsetzung übernimmt. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Ein Plus: Atlassian-Zertifizierungen (oder die Motivation, diese zu erwerben), Erfahrung mit ISO 27001 oder IT-Revisionen, ITIL/ITSM, Scripting (Groovy, Python, REST). Benefits Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit langfristiger Perspektive. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten – mit Büros in München und Leipzig. Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (AI, ITIL, ACP, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes und mehr). Moderne Ausstattung nach deinen Präferenzen (MacBook oder Windows). Als Platinum Partner tiefe Atlassian-Expertise im Haus – für jedes Spezialthema hast du Kolleg:innen an deiner Seite. Ein AI-first-Umfeld, in dem neue Arbeitsweisen nicht nur diskutiert, sondern gelebt werden. Flache Hierarchien und echte Verantwortung. Keine starre Rolle, in die du hineingepresst wirst – du gestaltest deine Verantwortung nach deinen Stärken und baust unser Banking-Geschäft aktiv mit auf. Freie Wahl der (AI-) Tools, die du in deinem Arbeitsalltag benötigst Klingt nach deinen Skills und deiner Perspektive für einen nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns auf darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam die Zukunft der Zusammenarbeit zu gestalten. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 10k to € 300k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.
